newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bus fares may rise 25 pct - minister.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bus fares may rise 25 pct - minister.

text.p: Venezuela's economic cabinet over the next few weeks will consider a proposal to increase intercity bus fares by 25 percent, Transport Minister Moises Orozco Graterol told reporters on Friday.
A fare increase would apply to some 1,600 routes and would be accompanied by a proposed 50 percent reduction in government transport subsidies.
The impact of such a fare increase on inflation still has to be worked out, Orozco said.

The minister said the monthly cost of the transport subsidies is some 3.4 billion ($7 million). The subsidies formed part of the government's initial effort to soften the social impact of tough economic reforms launched in April 1996.
